basic_details.offering_entity: Islamic Development Bank (IsDB, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.host_country: Global (Top Universities in 57 IsDB Member Countries and Partner Institutions Worldwide)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Top universities in IsDB member countries and prestigious partner universities worldwide (Cambridge, Oxford, Queen Mary, McGill, ITU Turkey, UTM Malaysia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Development-focused fields: Sustainability Sciences, Clean Energy, Climate Change, Agriculture and Food Security, Water and Sanitation, Healthcare and Medicine, ICT and AI, Islamic Economics, Finance and Banking, Infrastructure Development.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~500 to 600 scholarships awarded annually across 57 member countries
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Pakistan as a founding member country (~20 to 30 Pakistani scholars selected annually across all levels)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Bachelor's: 4 years; Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years; Post-Doc: 6 to 12 months

nationality_requirements: Citizen of an IsDB member country (Pakistani citizens eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate: under 24; Master's: under 30; PhD: under 35; Post-Doctoral: under 40 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 12 years for Bachelor's; 16 years for Master's; 18 years for PhD with superior academic standing (at least 'Very Good' / 80%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.50 / 4.00 CGPA or equivalent top 10% class standing.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Prerequisites corresponding to designated development disciplines.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of degree.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: None, provided age criteria are respected.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Work experience in public service or community development sectors evaluated favorably for Master's and PhD.

english_proficiency.notes: Language requirement depends on destination university (IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 85+ for UK/Canada/Malaysia programs).

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Language of instruction of destination university.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; women and marginalized groups actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Development impact and formal undertaking to return to home country and contribute to national development (structured as Qard Hasan / interest-free development investment).

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fees paid directly to the host university by the Islamic Development Bank.

admission_application_fee.details: University application fees paid by candidate unless waived.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living allowance commensurate with the cost of living in the host country (e.g. £1,200/mo in UK, CAD $1,600/mo in Canada, RM 2,000/mo in Malaysia).
monthly_stipend.amount: Local currency equivalent commensurate with host city cost of living

airfare.details: Economy class return airfare ticket between Pakistan and the host country at beginning and end of study.

visa_fee.details: Student visa fees reimbursed upon submission of official receipts.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive health and medical insurance provided throughout the study tenure.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Annual books and clothing allowance provided directly to student.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Special grant available for conference attendance and thesis preparation for PhD and Post-Doc scholars.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Installation allowance provided upon initial arrival.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Apply for study in top 10 universities in home country or renowned partner universities worldwide.
participating_institutions: Top universities in Pakistan (NUST, Quaid-i-Azam, Aga Khan University)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Premier global universities and top-tier institutions in IsDB member states.
available_majors: Clean Energy & Renewable Power, Sustainable Agriculture, Climate Science, Water Engineering, Public Health, Biomedical Sciences, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Islamic Economics & Finance, Law & Governance
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 4 years; Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Two pathways: Apply with an existing admission offer from an approved university, or apply for IsDB placement in partner universities.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Holding an unconditional admission offer from a top university significantly strengthens the IsDB scholarship application.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Align your proposed degree explicitly with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and Pakistan's socio-economic development plan.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the IsDB scholarship platform (Opens December/January), complete profile, upload academic dossier, and submit before deadline.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Check eligibility and program guidelines on the IsDB portal (Opens December/January).
2. Create account on the IsDB scholarship portal and complete the online application form.
3. Upload certified transcripts, degree certificates, CV, and Statement of Purpose.
4. Upload proof of admission if you already have an offer from a top university.
5. Submit online application before the annual deadline (typically late February).
6. IsDB selection panels screen applications and conduct interviews in April/May.
7. Final award decisions announced in July/August; placement confirmed.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct centralized application via IsDB portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters uploaded directly during portal application.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Address your academic motivation, how your degree aligns with IsDB development goals, and your commitment to return to Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Research proposal required for PhD and Post-Doctoral applicants.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Selection committee or national counter-part agency conducts video/in-person interview in April/May.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: Language proficiency test (IELTS/TOEFL) matching target university standards.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Transcripts certified by degree institutions; HEC attestation required.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English, Arabic, or French translations.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete certificates and mark sheets showing all grades and GPA
Detailed essay outlining academic background and development contribution
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clear focus on socio-economic impact in Pakistan

required_documents_checklist.specification: From former professors or professional supervisors on letterhead
Offer letter from an approved top university
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From top 10 Pakistani university or top international partner

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official medical certificate proving fitness for study
Valid Pakistani passport and national identity card
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Scanned copy of NADRA smart card and passport

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Application window is strictly December to late February each year. Final awards announced in July.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 20% (For PhD: quality and developmental relevance of research proposal)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Development impact of proposed study on home country)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: IsDB International Selection Committee composed of distinguished scholars and development experts.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase review: Technical evaluation of academic dossier and developmental alignment; final panel interview.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top-tier students with strong academic backgrounds, social impact initiatives, and clear development roadmaps.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of leading Pakistani universities (NUST, LUMS, Quaid-i-Azam, Aga Khan University, UET) in STEM, medicine, and economics.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Turkey, Malaysia, Indonesia, Egypt, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Morocco.

fake_websites_and_scams: Fraudulent websites claiming to charge fees for IsDB scholarship processing.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: The IsDB scholarship application is 100% FREE on the official portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never work through commercial consultants; apply directly on the IsDB portal.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: IsDB is a religious grant for theological studies. (Fact: Over 90% of IsDB scholarships are awarded in STEM, Medicine, Agriculture, AI, and Engineering).
MYTH: You cannot study in Western countries. (Fact: IsDB partners directly with Cambridge, Oxford, McGill, Queen Mary, and leading European universities).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: External blogs state this is a loan; IsDB scholarships operate as interest-free grants (Qard Hasan) where repayment is reinvested into the local community fund after return.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain high academic standing and pass all courses each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical residence and attendance at designated host university.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Host universities submit semi-annual academic progress reports to the IsDB Scholarship Division.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not work during their study period without prior approval from IsDB.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: MANDATORY Return: Scholars must return to their home country upon completion to serve in their profession and contribute to socio-economic development.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligated to return home and repay the cost of the scholarship in easy installments to a local IsDB community trust fund (so another student can benefit).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failing to return home or abandoning studies requires immediate full refund of all scholarship expenses.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Strictly prohibited without prior IsDB approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions are strictly granted only for documented academic research delays approved by IsDB.
